defmodule PdfGen.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for PDF generation requests"

  @hmac_key Application.compile_env(:pdf_gen, :hmac_secret, "default_secret_key_32bytes_long!")

  def verify_service_token(token) do
    case Base.decode64(token) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        <<signature::binary-size(32), data::binary>> = payload
        expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, data)
        if secure_compare(expected, signature) do
          {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(data, [:safe])}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_signature}
        end
      :error ->
        {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  def generate_service_token(claims) when is_map(claims) do
    data = :erlang.term_to_binary(claims)
    signature = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, data)
    Base.encode64(signature <> data)
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false
end

defmodule PdfGen.TemplateRegistry do
  @moduledoc "Registry of available PDF template renderers"

  @allowed_modules %{
    "invoice" => PdfGen.Templates.Invoice,
    "report" => PdfGen.Templates.Report,
    "receipt" => PdfGen.Templates.Receipt,
    "certificate" => PdfGen.Templates.Certificate
  }

  def resolve_template(template_name) when is_binary(template_name) do
    case Map.get(@allowed_modules, template_name) do
      nil -> {:error, :unknown_template}
      module -> {:ok, module}
    end
  end

  def resolve_template(template_spec) when is_map(template_spec) do
    case template_spec do
      %{"module" => mod_name, "function" => func_name} ->
        resolve_dynamic(mod_name, func_name)
      _ ->
        {:error, :invalid_spec}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_dynamic(mod_name, func_name) do
    module = String.to_existing_atom("Elixir." <> mod_name)
    function = String.to_existing_atom(func_name)
    if template_module?(module) do
      {:ok, {module, function}}
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized_module}
    end
  rescue
    ArgumentError -> {:error, :unknown_module}
  end

  defp template_module?(module) do
    module_str = Atom.to_string(module)
    String.starts_with?(module_str, "Elixir.PdfGen.Templates.")
  end
end

defmodule PdfGen.Renderer do
  @moduledoc "Core PDF rendering pipeline"

  def render(request) do
    with {:ok, claims} <- PdfGen.Auth.verify_service_token(request.token),
         {:ok, template} <- resolve_from_claims(claims),
         {:ok, pdf_binary} <- execute_render(template, claims["data"]) do
      {:ok, pdf_binary}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_from_claims(claims) do
    case claims do
      %{"template" => template_spec} when is_map(template_spec) ->
        PdfGen.TemplateRegistry.resolve_template(template_spec)
      %{"template" => name} when is_binary(name) ->
        PdfGen.TemplateRegistry.resolve_template(name)
      _ ->
        {:error, :no_template}
    end
  end

  defp execute_render({module, function}, data) do
    apply(module, function, [data])
  end

  defp execute_render(module, data) when is_atom(module) do
    apply(module, :render, [data])
  end
end

defmodule PdfGen.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/api/v1/render" do
    token = get_req_header(conn, "x-service-token") |> List.first()
    case PdfGen.Renderer.render(%{token: token}) do
      {:ok, pdf} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/pdf")
        |> send_resp(200, pdf)
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn |> send_resp(403, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end
end
